description: Source code for the LoanSecurityPledge document in the loan management module, including methods for validation, pledge amount calculation, and loan updates.

classes.name: LoanSecurityPledge
classes.description: Represents a pledge of loan securities with validation and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks before saving the document, including pledge amount setting and duplicate security validation.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the pledge is submitted, such as updating status and loan details.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the pledge is canceled, including resetting status and updating the loan.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_securities
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate securities are added to the pledge.

methods.name: validate_loan_security_type
methods.description: Validates that all securities have the same LTV ratio for a given loan.

methods.name: set_pledge_amount
methods.description: Calculates total security value and maximum loan value based on pledged securities.
